adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the booking query includes `user: { include: { credentials: true } }`, but those organizer credentials are never used. Instead, the code builds the `EventManager` with the acting session `user` and `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)`, then calls `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)`. If a team admin/owner or an attendee (both allowed by the permission checks) adds guests, this will attempt to update the external calendar event using their credentials rather than the booking organizer’s, which can prevent updating the organizer’s connected calendar event.
